test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 24 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence:

As Gagan wanted to be selected in the team, __**so he worked very hard.**__
solution:
The correct answer is '**he worked very hard**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The sentence uses the past tense to describe an action ("worked very hard") that occurred in the past, as Gagan wanted to be selected in the team.
 
• The word "so" is redundant in the given sentence, as it breaks the grammatical flow.
 
• Option 2 ("he worked very hard") is correct because it correctly follows the subject-verb-object structure without unnecessary conjunctions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"As Gagan wanted to be selected in the team, he worked very hard."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "so he work very hard"** is incorrect as "work" is in present tense and does not align with the past tense of the sentence.
 
• **Option 3: "and he worked very hard"** is incorrect as "and" changes the intended meaning of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "because he worked very hard"** is incorrect as it does not fit with the cause-and-effect relationship implied in the original sentence.
